description: Country immigration profile (beyond investment migration): ALL screened pathways for a country — skilled-work, digital-nomad, retirement, citizenship-by-descent, naturalisation, study, family etc. — each with requirements, cost, processing, rights, path to PR/citizenship and the official source. Use the ISO-3166 alpha-2 code (e.g. CA, GB, DE, PT).

nationality.description: optional: the applicant's citizenship (ISO alpha-2 or name). For an EU/EEA/Swiss citizen in an EU/EEA country or Switzerland, free movement is shown as their route, national visas are marked not needed and golden visas are omitted.

pathway.description: optional: one pathway id to return

name: get_country

outputSchema.description: Mirabello envelope; tool fields vary; error only on failure.
